name: 会话消息自动清理
description: 在签到执行完成后按配置延迟自动删除触发指令与 Bot 回复消息，保持会话整洁。
author: TG-SignPulse

params_schema.name: delay_seconds
params_schema.label: 清理延迟秒数
params_schema.description: 清理消息前的等待缓冲时间（秒）

params_schema.name: delete_bot_reply
params_schema.label: 删除 Bot 回复
params_schema.description: 是否删除 Bot 响应发出的消息

params_schema.name: delete_trigger_command
params_schema.label: 删除触发口令
params_schema.description: 是否删除用户发送的签到/触发命令消息

description_en: Automatically delays and cleans up user trigger commands and bot replies after check-in to keep chat history clean.
features: Cleans bot replies and original trigger commands
Safely handles missing reply_to references and already-deleted messages
